findings.affected_surface: CLI command option combination: git log -L with --raw/--name-only/--name-status/--summary
findings.old_behavior: git log -L with --raw, --name-only, --name-status, or --summary dies with "-L does not yet support the requested diff format"
findings.new_behavior: git log -L with --raw, --name-only, --name-status, or --summary succeeds and outputs metadata-only diff content (filepair fields: mode, oid, status, path)
findings.compatibility_reason: The format allowlist for -L (line-level-traverse) is expanded from PATCH|NO_OUTPUT to also allow RAW, NAME, NAME_STATUS, and SUMMARY. This is an additive/relaxing change: previously erroring option combinations now produce output. No existing git commands or scripts that previously worked will break, but scripts that explicitly tested for the error (test_must_fail) would need updating. This is a documented feature addition per commit message.

evidence.snippet:
if (revs->line_level_traverse &&
    (revs->full_diff ||
     (revs->diffopt.output_format &
      ~(DIFF_FORMAT_PATCH | DIFF_FORMAT_NO_OUTPUT |
        DIFF_FORMAT_RAW | DIFF_FORMAT_NAME |
        DIFF_FORMAT_NAME_STATUS | DIFF_FORMAT_SUMMARY))))
    die(_("-L does not yet support the requested diff format"));

findings.why_not_internal_only: setup_revisions() is a public API declared in revision.h and directly affects CLI command behavior for git log -L; the change is externally observable as new option combinations producing output instead of errors.
findings.uncertainty: The change is purely additive; no measurable risk of breaking existing scripts. The only theoretical breakage is tests that explicitly assert --raw fails with -L (as the old test did).
findings.recommended_review: Verify that --raw/--name-only/--name-status/--summary output with -L is correct for edge cases (empty range, binary files, merge commits, root commits, renamed files).
findings.test_recommendation: Run t4211-line-log.sh regression tests which cover all four newly allowed formats plus verify that --stat/--numstat/--shortstat/--dirstat remain blocked.
